title: What Remains Human in Mathematics in the Age of AI
summary: Mathematics is often valued for its role as the language of science, but it is equally important as a human practice that teaches us how to think and cultivates creativity, problem-solving skills, attention, and judgment. The rapid rise of modern AI systems, which can solve many standard problems and produce fluent mathematical explanations, forces a reconsideration of the nature of mathematical understanding and how it is developed.
